full_judgment: 4. During pendency of the suit the plaintiff-opposite party no. 1 filed an application under Order VI Rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure on 9.1.2001 for amendment of the plaint. By the said application plaintiff sought amendment of paragraph 2 of the plaint substituting some words replacing the words incorporated earlier. By the suit amendment the plaintiff wanted to have an amendment changing the number of Khatian, dag and quantum of land. The said amendment application was allowed by the learned Assistant Judge, Kishoregonj which is under challenge in this revisional application.
